# Apps partners

## Build integrations between Stripe and other systems to extend the functionality of Stripe and list them on the Stripe App Marketplace.

App partners [build an app](https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/how-stripe-apps-work) and then submit it for [app review](https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/publish-app) to list it on the [Stripe App Marketplace](https://marketplace.stripe.com/). After Stripe approves and publishes the app, you become eligible for benefits. You receive additional premier benefits when you reach volume thresholds.

## Stripe Partner and Premier Partner requirements

## Program benefits for Apps partners

| | Partner | Premier |
|---|---|---|
| **Build** | | |
| Get access to dedicated app integration checklists, sample code, and UI templates | | |
| Get access to technical training and certification on Stripe products | | |
| Access to the [Stripe Apps GitHub](https://github.com/stripe/stripe-apps) to submit tickets, track request progress, and engage with the apps technical teams | | |
| Join the Stripe community through [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/stripe) and connect with other developers through Stripe Apps. | | |
| Invitation to join quarterly Stripe App Partner webinars, including product roadmap previews | | |
| Access to Stripe partner portal with support | | |
| Invitation to Stripe Apps product private previews | | |
| Fast-track app review | | |
| **Market** | | |
| Eligible to participate in developer meetups, write technical blog posts, and record demos | | |
| Eligible for App Marketplace featured placement | | |
| Access to marketing content, campaign assets, how-to guides, and templates | | |
| Stripe Partner badge and co-branding guidelines | | |
| Partner directory listing | | |
| App Marketplace listing | | |
| Eligible for developer or joint customer case studies | | |

| Early access to Stripe Sessions, and events sponsorships | | |

| Eligible for Stripe participation in partner-hosted online events | | |
| Eligible for speaking opportunities at Stripe events | | |
